Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Working night shifts? Eat your main meal before work and keep the after-shift bite small. 🌙 In Episode 6 of our Uncle Lim family story, a knock at midnight brings Mei's younger brother Jun home with a new factory job and two bags of late-night takeaway. A family argument at half past one, one good question from our pharmacist at the 24-hour mamak, and Jun packs his own dinner for the next shift. A few habits that help shift workers in Johor Bahru: • Main meal around 6 to 7pm before an 8pm start • A lighter tiffin in the first half of the shift • Coffee early, plain water in the last few hours • A small bowl of oats or fruit before daytime sleep • Dark curtains, and the phone kept in a drawer Want a plan that fits your roster? Ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling at Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, or walk in for a Minute Consult with our pharmacist, no appointment needed. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open every day, 10AM to 10PM.
